riskScoreDialogDescription: The score rates this site's privacy from 1 (very good) to 5 (critical), based on tracker count, cookie behaviour, and privacy violations.
riskScore2Explanation: This site uses barely any trackers.
riskScore2Recommendation: Your data largely stays with you.
riskScore3Explanation: This site sends your data to multiple third parties.
riskScore3Recommendation: You can still browse, just be aware.
riskScore4Explanation: This site monitors your browsing behaviour extensively.
riskScore4Recommendation: Use an ad blocker and avoid sharing sensitive data.
riskScore5Explanation: This site actively violates your privacy.
riskScore5Recommendation: Avoid sensitive activities on this site.
dsgvoArt7Title: Art. 7 GDPR: Consent Required Before Data Collection
dsgvoArt7FineExplanation: No cookies were set before your consent. This site complies with Art. 7 GDPR.
dsgvoArt7FineRecommendation: All good. Consent is correctly implemented.
dsgvoArt7SuspiciousExplanation: A cookie banner was detected, but cookies or trackers are already active. Consent may not be awaited.
dsgvoArt7SuspiciousRecommendation: Check whether the active cookies are technically necessary or should only be set after consent.
dsgvoArt7ConfirmedExplanation: This site sets cookies and sends data to external services before you've confirmed anything. Your consent would be required first.
dsgvoArt7ConfirmedRecommendation: All non-essential cookies must only be set after active consent. Review the cookie banner implementation.
dsgvoArt1314Title: Art. 13/14 GDPR: Duty to Inform About Data Collection
dsgvoArt1314FineExplanation: A link to the privacy policy was found. This site fulfils the information obligation under Art. 13/14 GDPR.
dsgvoArt1314FineRecommendation: All good. The privacy policy is accessible.
dsgvoArt1314SuspiciousExplanation: A possible link to the privacy policy was found, but its placement or labelling is unclear.
dsgvoArt1314SuspiciousRecommendation: Manually check whether the link actually leads to the privacy policy.
dsgvoArt1314ConfirmedExplanation: No link to a privacy policy was found. Under Art. 13/14 GDPR, website operators must inform users about data processing.
dsgvoArt1314ConfirmedRecommendation: Add a clearly visible link to the privacy policy, e.g. in the footer or navigation.
dsgvoArt25FineExplanation: The site uses HTTPS and no high-risk trackers were detected. This aligns with the privacy by design principle.
dsgvoArt25FineRecommendation: All good. Technical safeguards are appropriate.
dsgvoArt25SuspiciousExplanation: The site uses HTTPS, but trackers or fingerprinting were detected. Browser fingerprinting enables user re-identification without cookies, undermining the data minimisation principle.
dsgvoArt25SuspiciousRecommendation: Review the tracking tools in use and ensure consent is obtained for all of them.
dsgvoArt25ConfirmedExplanation: High-risk trackers were detected or the connection is not encrypted. This violates the privacy by design principle under Art. 25 GDPR.
dsgvoArt25ConfirmedRecommendation: Remove high-risk trackers, ensure HTTPS is used, and obtain consent correctly.
